snippet.title: Lost Treasure Of Lima - Trailer
snippet.description:
Lost Treasure of Lima is a platformer game, made by drgd_retro, featuring environmental puzzles, exploration and race-against-the-clock action sequences.

https://www.brokestudio.fr/product/lost-treasure-of-lima-gb/

_______________________________

Story

In 1820 Captain William Thompson was put in charge of transporting Spains riches from Lima to Mexico

Unable to resist the treasures temptation they turned pirate.

Heading for Cocos Island off the coast of Costa Rica Thompson and his men allegedly buried the treasure.

Thompson and the crew were eventually captured and put on trial for piracy.

The treasure has forever lain dormant. Now the hunt begins...

_______________________________

The game features

• 4 levels
• environmental puzzles
• race-against-the-clock action sequences
• hidden collectables
• secret endings

_______________________________
